indications: 美国说明书：与 LHRH 类似物合用，治疗转移性前列腺癌。
contraindications: 对成分过敏或妊娠。美国说明书未批准女性使用。
majorWarnings: 可发生严重肝损伤；注意乳房胀痛。合用 LHRH 类似物时可能影响血糖。

monitoring: 肝功能；合用抗凝药时监测 INR；合用 LHRH 类似物时监测血糖。

en.summary: A synthetic progestogen with antiandrogenic activity.

indications: France: selected gynecological disorders when alternatives are inappropriate.
Japan: prostatic hyperplasia or prostate cancer, subject to label restrictions.
contraindications: France: meningioma/history, active thrombosis, severe hepatic dysfunction, unexplained genital bleeding, hypersensitivity.
majorWarnings: Meningioma risk increases with cumulative exposure; hepatic, thrombotic, mood and glucose risks.
majorInteractions: Enzyme inducers may reduce progestogenic effects.
monitoring: Liver function, glucose, meningioma symptoms and imaging per local labeling.

sourceRefs.title: PMDA: Chlormadinone acetate tablets 25 mg YD (Japan)

mechanisms: Progestogenic activity, androgen antagonism and gonadotropin suppression.

zh-CN.summary: 兼有抗雄激素作用的合成孕激素。

indications: 法国：部分月经异常、子宫内膜异位症等，仅在其他治疗不适合时使用。
日本：前列腺肥大症或前列腺癌，适用条件见所引说明书。
contraindications: 法国：脑膜瘤或病史、活动性血栓、严重肝功能异常、不明原因生殖道出血及成分过敏。
日本：重度肝损伤或肝病。
majorWarnings: 脑膜瘤风险随累积暴露增加；还需注意肝损伤、血栓、情绪变化及血糖异常。
majorInteractions: 酶诱导剂可降低孕激素作用。
monitoring: 肝功能、血糖、脑膜瘤相关症状及按当地说明书安排的影像随访。

en.summary: An estrogen mixture; information here concerns Premarin oral tablets.

indications: US Premarin: menopausal symptoms, selected hypoestrogenic conditions, osteoporosis prevention and selected cancer palliation.
contraindications: Unexplained genital bleeding, estrogen-dependent cancer, thrombosis/history, thrombophilia, liver disease or severe allergy; breast cancer/history except selected metastatic treatment.
majorWarnings: Thrombotic, cardiovascular, breast and endometrial risks. Not indicated in pregnancy.
monitoring: Abnormal bleeding; thyroid function during thyroid replacement.

zh-CN.summary: 雌激素混合物；此处资料以 Premarin 口服片剂为例。

indications: 美国 Premarin 片剂：绝经相关症状、某些低雌激素状态及绝经后骨质疏松预防；也用于特定乳腺癌或前列腺癌的姑息治疗。
contraindications: 不明原因生殖道出血、雌激素依赖肿瘤、血栓或病史、易栓症、肝病、严重过敏。乳腺癌或病史者禁用，特定转移性肿瘤治疗除外。
majorWarnings: 注意血栓及心血管事件、乳腺及子宫内膜风险；妊娠期不适用。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 诱导剂或抑制剂可改变雌激素暴露。
monitoring: 异常出血；合用甲状腺替代治疗时监测甲状腺功能。

en.summary: An androgen receptor blocker with progestogenic activity.

indications: UK Androcur: selected severe hypersexuality when alternatives are inappropriate.
UK Cyprostat: selected prostate cancer treatment and associated hot flushes.
contraindications: Androcur label: liver disease/tumors, meningioma/history, thrombosis/history, severe depression, severe vascular diabetes, sickle-cell anemia, wasting disease, non-prostate malignancy or hypersensitivity; excludes under-18s.
majorWarnings: Meningioma with cumulative exposure; serious liver injury, thrombosis and long-term bone loss.
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 inhibitors/inducers affect exposure; high doses with some statins increase myopathy risk.
monitoring: Liver function, blood count, meningioma symptoms; glucose in diabetes.

timeCourse.formulation: 50 mg tablets; single100 mg oral study

doseUseReferences.reviewedLabelMatch: SOC8 AppendixC Table4 pS254; numeric fact; footnotes reviewed

mechanisms: Androgen receptor blockade and gonadotropin suppression.

zh-CN.summary: 兼有孕激素作用的雄激素受体阻断药。

indications: 英国 Androcur：其他干预不适合的特定严重性欲亢进。
英国 Cyprostat：特定前列腺癌治疗及相关潮热。
女性化激素治疗中的抗雄用药（WPATH 指南）。
contraindications: 所引 Androcur 说明书：肝病或肝肿瘤、脑膜瘤或病史、血栓或病史、严重抑郁、伴血管病变的严重糖尿病、镰状细胞贫血、消耗性疾病、除前列腺癌外的恶性肿瘤及成分过敏；不适用于18岁以下。
majorWarnings: 注意累积暴露相关脑膜瘤、严重肝损伤、血栓和长期骨量减少风险。
majorInteractions: CYP3A4 抑制剂或诱导剂可改变暴露；高剂量合用部分他汀类可增加肌病风险。
monitoring: 肝功能、血细胞计数及脑膜瘤相关症状；糖尿病患者监测血糖。

timeCourse.formulation: 50 mg 片剂，单次口服100 mg资料

doseUseReferences.indication: 女性化激素治疗（WPATH SOC8 表4）
